description: Use for "where is the arbitrage" and "Kalshi vs Polymarket price gaps". Cross-venue gaps on the same sports game (NFL, NBA, NHL, MLB): Kalshi against Polymarket US — the exchange US traders use, fees included — with Polymarket's international book as a reference only. The gap in pp, the WATCH/ARB signal, the cheaper venue and whether both contracts settle the same way (settlement_match). Nothing over the line returns the closest near misses. Free: the top 3 gaps in full; Pro returns the whole board.

minGap.description: Minimum gap in percentage points to include (default 3 = WATCH threshold). Accepts a number or a numeric string ("3", "3pp", "3%").
